messages:
maya: Heads-up — EU canary started spitting `model-binding-error` after we unpinned runtime to 2.15.0 and bumped SDK to 3.2.1. Seeing ~4% failures in requests to llama3q. Logs show kernel sig mismatch.

deploybot: [deploy] canary: runtime-2.15.0 unpin -> completed at 4445556600. No rollback triggered.

alex: Ugh. Is this isolated to EU or hitting us globally?

maya: so far only eu-west-1. US and APAC look fine.

sam: quick question — did we also bump the model variant? Could be quant kernel mismatch.

maya: model stayed same (llama3q-v1). Runtime change altered kernel selection for 1280 seq paths.

jordan: Let's not touch global. Proposal: pin runtime for eu region back to 2.14.3 and keep SDK 3.2.1 for now. We'll fail the canary but avoid user impact.

li: Agreed. If we pin runtime, we need to update release notes + backfill compatibility note in the SDK changelog.

maya: Plan:
1) Pin runtime in EU (deploybot command below)
2) Trigger canary rollback to runtime 2.14.3 in eu-west-1
3) Run smoke tests for long-seq/quant paths
4) Draft customer blurb and release note entry

maya: Deploybot command:
```
/deploybot pin add --region eu --component runtime --version 2.14.3 --reason "kernel-sig mismatch after 2.15.0 unpin"
```

alex: I'll open the rollback PR for canary rollback script. Sam can you run the smoke suite once it's pinned?

sam: on it. ETA ~15m after pin.

deploybot: pin added: runtime=2.14.3 region=eu by maya at 4445556625. Canaries will be routed to pinned version until lifted. :white_check_mark: 

maya: sending note to cs/incident channel, cc'ing legal for EU compliance just in case. Will update change window and release notes.

jordan: also add an SDK compatibility lint to the CI: flag if SDK-major doesn't match runtime kernel signature support.

li: I can add a quick eval test to catch this next time — will send PR after monitoring.

maya: follow-up: if pin doesn't reduce failures to <0.5% in 30m we'll rollback SDK to 3.2.0. else we'll keep pinned and do a hotfix runtime patch.

deploybot: canary rollback scheduled: runtime->2.14.3 in eu-west-1, start=4445556680. Will post updates here.

sam: smoke results after pin: latency/throughput looks normal. Error rate dropped to 0.3% at 10m.

maya: thanks team. keeping pin for now. I'll update release notes: add compatibility caveat for SDK 3.2.1 + runtime 2.15.0 for long-seq quant.

alex: file a postmortem checklist item: better model/runtime pairing matrix and automated gating.

maya: noted. Closing loop once change window updated and docs patched.
